entries.016d9d6fa005c113: SHIZUOKA GAS CO.,LTD. is a comprehensive energy company that supplies city gas, LPG, and electricity, mainly in the central and eastern parts of Shizuoka Prefecture.
entries.08d59be33d505312: This business supplies and sells city gas and sells LNG (liquefied natural gas). Shimizu LNG purchases LNG and LPG from the company, produces product gas and sells all of it to the company. Consolidated subsidiaries including Yoshida Gas, Chūen Gas, Fukuroi Gas, Shimada Gas and Gotemba Gas supply and sell gas in their respective areas, and SHIZUOKA GAS AMERICA, established in the United States in 2025, is pursuing a shale gas development business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥155,167 million, making it the largest business in the group.
entries.0acaeb039fb41de3: It conducts leasing, insurance agency, nursing-care-related businesses, information processing and systems development, staffing and gas delivery, among others.
entries.0c3b4c1f7b09ae52: Since its founding in 1910, it has continued city gas operations in central and eastern Shizuoka Prefecture and has a customer base rooted in the region. A distinguishing feature is its integrated energy business structure: the group handles everything from importing LNG to producing and supplying finished gas, and in addition to gas, it can offer LPG, electricity, and lifestyle services to customers in the same region.
entries.18b84bbf5c0074ba: It carries out maintenance of gas facilities, gas construction and air-conditioning construction, among others.

entries.6e25ee05ea6cf941: It sells gas and fire alarms and housing equipment, conducts renovation business, and designs, builds and sells custom-built and ready-built homes, among other activities.

Major wholesale supply destinations stated in the filing are [[company:inpex|INPEX]] and Sāra Energy.

entries.b9ee4c74ca67c3a6: As of December 31, 2025, the group consists of the company, 33 consolidated subsidiaries, 7 equity-method affiliates, and 1 non-equity-method affiliate; the number of consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is 1,586.
entries.b9f78af62fa34005: The Shizuoka Gas Group is a business model that earns revenue by importing LNG to manufacture and supply city gas, and by selling LPG and electricity and providing services such as gas construction and renovation.

In addition, it sells LPG and electricity, provides on-site energy services, performs gas piping work, sells gas appliances, renovates, and so on.

entries.f2b49b1fe12ad750: Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥155,167 million for gas, the largest, ¥29,845 million for LPG and other energy, and ¥16,195 million for other. Gas sales volume was 1,595 million m³; by use, industrial use was the largest at 858 million m³, and wholesale supply was 575 million m³. Domestic sales account for more than 90% of revenue.
entries.f8ac692c8d93fdbe: This business sells LPG and electricity and provides on-site energy services.
entries.f9f0e6dca3f49c76: Under its corporate philosophy, “Through the comprehensive strength of the group centered on energy, we will pursue a rich and sustainable future,” it aims to realize “regional co-creation,” set out in the “Group 2030 Vision.” In its core city gas and LPG business, it gives top priority to “safety and security,” striving to ensure safety and stable supply, and will expand the use of natural gas and its customer base. As growth businesses, it will work to expand its electricity and renewable energy business, lifestyle and engineering services business, and overseas business.
entries.f9f25a2cd508b7e8: Shizuoka Gas & Power generates electricity and buys and sells electricity. It purchases gas from the company and sells electricity to the company.
entries.fb533a424dd4e01c: Centered on the central and eastern part of Shizuoka Prefecture, the company supplies and sells gas through pipelines to residential, commercial and industrial customers, and also provides wholesale supply to other gas operators.
